description: Structured project knowledge extracted from the document.

project_metadata.description: Project-level information explicitly stated or clearly described in the document.

description.description: A concise description of the project, its purpose, or what is being built.

stakeholders.description: People, teams, organizations, or roles identified as stakeholders in the project.

items.description: A stakeholder identified in the document.

name.description: Name of the stakeholder, if explicitly available.

role.description: The stakeholder's role or relationship to the project.

organization.description: The organization or company associated with the stakeholder, if available.

business_objectives.description: Business goals or outcomes the project is intended to achieve.

items.description: A specific business objective stated or clearly described in the document.

functional_requirements.description: Specific capabilities or behaviors the system or product must provide.

items.description: A specific functional requirement stated or clearly described in the document.

non_functional_requirements.description: Requirements describing quality attributes, performance, security, availability, scalability, compliance, or other non-functional characteristics.

items.description: A non-functional requirement identified in the document.

category.description: The category of the non-functional requirement, such as security, performance, availability, scalability, or compliance.

assumptions.description: Statements treated as assumptions about the project, users, environment, technology, or business.

items.description: A specific project assumption stated or clearly implied by the document.

constraints.description: Known limitations or restrictions affecting the project.

items.description: A specific project constraint stated or clearly described in the document.

risks.description: Potential events, conditions, or issues that could negatively affect the project.

items.description: A specific project risk stated or clearly described in the document.

decisions.description: Explicit decisions that have been made about the project.

items.description: A specific project decision stated in the document.

out_of_scope.description: Features, capabilities, activities, or areas explicitly excluded from the project scope.

items.description: A specific item explicitly identified as out of scope.

open_questions.description: Questions, ambiguities, or unresolved issues that require clarification.

items.description: A specific open question or unresolved issue identified in the document.
